parameters.query:
SELECT jsonb_build_object(
  'tenant_id', cc.tenant_id,
  'conversation_id', cc.id,
  'message_id', cm.id,
  'customer_message', cm.body_text,
  'subject', cm.subject,
  'customer_name', COALESCE(c.first_name,''),
  'store_name', COALESCE(t.settings->>'store_name',''),
  'reply_ai_enabled', COALESCE((t.settings->>'reply_ai_enabled')::boolean,false),
  'verified_facts', COALESCE(t.settings->'reply_knowledge_base','{}'::jsonb),
  'conversation_history', COALESCE((
    SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('direction', h.direction, 'body_text', h.body_text) ORDER BY h.created_at)
    FROM (
      SELECT 'OUTBOUND'::text AS direction, m.body AS body_text, m.created_at
      FROM henvalt.delivery_requests dr
      JOIN henvalt.messages m ON m.id=dr.message_reference AND m.tenant_id=dr.tenant_id
      WHERE dr.id=cc.delivery_request_id
      UNION ALL
      SELECT cm2.direction, cm2.body_text, cm2.received_at
      FROM henvalt.conversation_messages cm2
      WHERE cm2.conversation_id=cc.id AND cm2.tenant_id=cc.tenant_id
    ) h
  ), '[]'::jsonb)
) AS context
FROM henvalt.conversation_messages cm
JOIN henvalt.customer_conversations cc ON cc.id=cm.conversation_id AND cc.tenant_id=cm.tenant_id
JOIN henvalt.customers c ON c.id=cc.customer_id AND c.tenant_id=cc.tenant_id
JOIN henvalt.tenants t ON t.id=cc.tenant_id
WHERE cm.id=$1::uuid AND cc.id=$2::uuid AND cm.direction='INBOUND'

parameters.query:
WITH saved AS (
  UPDATE henvalt.conversation_messages
  SET intent=$4,
      ai_status=CASE WHEN $5::boolean THEN 'NEEDS_HUMAN' ELSE 'DRAFTED' END,
      ai_draft=NULLIF($6,'')
  WHERE tenant_id=$1::uuid AND conversation_id=$2::uuid AND id=$3::uuid
    AND direction='INBOUND'
  RETURNING tenant_id,conversation_id,id
)
UPDATE henvalt.customer_conversations cc
SET status=CASE WHEN $5::boolean THEN 'HUMAN_REQUIRED' ELSE 'OPEN' END,
    updated_at=now()
FROM saved
WHERE cc.tenant_id=saved.tenant_id AND cc.id=saved.conversation_id
  AND cc.status NOT IN ('OPTED_OUT','CLOSED')
RETURNING saved.id AS message_id, cc.status AS conversation_status

parameters.query:
WITH failed AS (
  UPDATE henvalt.conversation_messages
  SET ai_status='FAILED', ai_draft=NULL
  WHERE id=$1::uuid AND conversation_id=$2::uuid
  RETURNING tenant_id,conversation_id
)
UPDATE henvalt.customer_conversations cc
SET status='HUMAN_REQUIRED',updated_at=now()
FROM failed
WHERE cc.tenant_id=failed.tenant_id AND cc.id=failed.conversation_id
  AND cc.status NOT IN ('OPTED_OUT','CLOSED')
RETURNING cc.id AS conversation_id
